# Mindfulness (Z Meditations)

> Mindfulness is a guided meditation app for iPhone and iPad, on the App Store since 2012. It has more than 100 guided sessions from 2 minutes long, multi-day programs, breathing exercises, a meditation timer and a mood diary. Free to download with free content forever; Mindfulness Pro unlocks the rest. Available in 10 languages. No account needed. Not available on Android.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id572966485
- Developer: Z Meditations, contact zmeditations@gmail.com
- Devices: iPhone and iPad only
- Languages: Spanish, English, German, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
- It is a wellbeing app, not a medical or psychological treatment

## Pages (Spanish)

- [Inicio](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/): what the app is, what is free, what is inside
- [Ayuda](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/soporte/): 17 short answers (free content, restoring purchases, cancelling, diary in iCloud, languages, contact)
- [5 días para empezar el año](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/reto/): the "Empieza a meditar" program, free in January
- [Privacidad](https://www.zmeditations.com/privacy.html): privacy policy
